title: It's a Crime, Mr. Collins
paragraphs: A detective series about private investigator Greg Collins, with many of his cases narrated from the perspective of his wife, Gail, as the couple encounters crime at home and while traveling.
Australian Crawford Productions version, distinct from the lost 1956-57 American Mutual series. Titles use a color motif; dates align with the maintained Australian episode log.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Australian Crawford Productions run (March 4, 1957 to 1958).
Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Keith Eden (performer) and Mary Disney (performer).

The stories often return to private detective investigation, married detective partnership, color-title mystery convention, Australian radio syndication, murder investigation, and jealousy and romantic complications.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Australian Crawford Productions Mr Collins run and Distinct from lost American Mutual production.
